steps.name: environment
steps.description: Prepare workspace, persist only safe global variables, securely store FIGMA_API_TOKEN under the workspace with least privilege, produce a loader that reads token from workspace, and emit version evidence for Node/npm/tsc/yarn. Do not export PROJECT_ID to global profile (considered potentially sensitive).
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/figma-project-1865-1874/FigmaWorkspace"
sudo mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE" && sudo chown "$(id -u):$(id -g)" "$WORKSPACE"
# Persist only safe global env (NODE_ENV). Avoid exporting PROJECT_ID globally.
sudo tee /etc/profile.d/figma_workspace.sh >/dev/null <<'EOF'
export NODE_ENV="development"
EOF
sudo chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/figma_workspace.sh
# Securely store FIGMA_API_TOKEN in workspace (only if provided to the agent env)
if [ -n "${FIGMA_API_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/.figma" && printf '%s' "${FIGMA_API_TOKEN}" > "$WORKSPACE/.figma/token" && chmod 600 "$WORKSPACE/.figma/token" && chown "$(id -u):$(id -g)" "$WORKSPACE/.figma/token"
  mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/bin"
  cat > "$WORKSPACE/bin/load_figma_env.sh" <<EOF
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
TOKEN_PATH="$WORKSPACE/.figma/token"
if [ -f "$TOKEN_PATH" ]; then export FIGMA_API_TOKEN="$(cat "$TOKEN_PATH")"; fi
EOF
  chmod 700 "$WORKSPACE/bin/load_figma_env.sh"
fi
# Emit versions and record to /tmp for diagnostic evidence
NODE_V=$(node -v 2>/dev/null || echo 'v0') || true
NODE_MAJOR=${NODE_V#v}; NODE_MAJOR=${NODE_MAJOR%%.*}
printf '%s\n' "$NODE_V" > /tmp/figma_node_version.txt || true
npm -v >/tmp/figma_npm_version.txt 2>/dev/null || true
command -v tsc >/dev/null && tsc -v >/tmp/figma_tsc_version.txt 2>/dev/null || true
command -v yarn >/dev/null && yarn -v >/tmp/figma_yarn_version.txt 2>/dev/null || true
# Numeric compare safe: if NODE_MAJOR is empty or non-numeric treat as 0
NODE_MAJOR=${NODE_MAJOR:-0}
if ! printf '%s' "$NODE_MAJOR" | grep -qE '^[0-9]+'; then NODE_MAJOR=0; fi
if [ "$NODE_MAJOR" -lt 16 ]; then echo "warning: node <16 detected" >/tmp/figma_env_warnings.txt || true; fi
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE"
echo "env_ok" > "$WORKSPACE/.setup_env_done"

steps.name: scaffold project
steps.description: Initialize a minimal npm project skeleton if missing (package.json, tsconfig.json when appropriate), create src/public/assets, add a safe start wrapper that prefers local serve binary and fails clearly otherwise. Merge npm scripts atomically using node -e to avoid fragile parsing. Do not overwrite existing files; create .generated copies when originals exist.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/figma-project-1865-1874/FigmaWorkspace"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# Initialize package.json if missing
if [ ! -f package.json ]; then npm init -y >/tmp/figma_init_pkg.json 2>&1 || { cat /tmp/figma_init_pkg.json; exit 2; }; fi
# Merge scripts atomically using node to avoid fragile npm pkg parsing
node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='$WORKSPACE/package.json';let j={};if(fs.existsSync(p)){j=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p));}j.scripts=j.scripts||{};if(!j.scripts.start) j.scripts.start='node ./dist/index.js'; if(!j.scripts.build) j.scripts.build='tsc -p tsconfig.json'; fs.writeFileSync(p,JSON.stringify(j,null,2));"
# Ensure tsconfig if missing
if [ ! -f tsconfig.json ]; then
  cat > tsconfig.json <<'TS'
{ "compilerOptions": { "target": "ES2020", "module": "commonjs", "outDir": "dist", "rootDir": "src", "strict": true } }
TS
else
  cp -f "tsconfig.json" "tsconfig.json.generated" 2>/dev/null || true
fi
mkdir -p src public assets bin
# Create lightweight entry if missing; preserve existing by creating generated copy
if [ ! -f src/index.ts ] && [ ! -f src/index.js ]; then
  cat > src/index.ts <<'TS'
console.log('FigmaWorkspace initialized')
TS
else
  if [ -f src/index.ts ]; then cp -f "src/index.ts" "src/index.ts.generated" 2>/dev/null || true; elif [ -f src/index.js ]; then cp -f "src/index.js" "src/index.js.generated" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
fi
# .gitignore
if [ ! -f .gitignore ]; then printf "node_modules/\ndist/\n.env\n" > .gitignore; fi
# Start wrapper: prefer local node_modules/.bin/serve; fail clearly if missing (no npx fallback)
cat > "$WORKSPACE/bin/start_preview.sh" <<'SH'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="$WORKSPACE"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
if [ -x "$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/serve" ]; then exec "$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/serve" -s public -l 5000; else echo "error: local 'serve' not found. Run the 'install' (deps) step to install local dependencies." >&2; exit 3; fi
SH
chmod +x "$WORKSPACE/bin/start_preview.sh"
echo "scaffold_ok" > "$WORKSPACE/.setup_scaffold_done"

steps.name: install dependencies
steps.description: Install project-local runtime and dev dependencies. Prefer installing devDependencies locally for reproducibility; if skipping local install due to global presence, emit a warning record. Puppeteer installation is opt-in (USE_PUPPETEER=1). If puppeteer is chosen and Chromium is absent and downloads are disabled, fail with a clear message. Capture installer logs to /tmp/figma_install.log for diagnostics.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/figma-project-1865-1874/FigmaWorkspace"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
LOG=/tmp/figma_install.log
: > "$LOG"
# Base runtime and dev packages
RUNTIME_PKGS=(axios serve)
DEV_PKGS=(ts-jest @types/jest jest typescript)
# Decide puppeteer vs puppeteer-core
USE_PUPPETEER=${USE_PUPPETEER:-0}
# Detect system chromium path
CHROMIUM_BIN=""
if [ -x "/usr/bin/chromium" ]; then CHROMIUM_BIN="/usr/bin/chromium"; elif [ -x "/usr/bin/chromium-browser" ]; then CHROMIUM_BIN="/usr/bin/chromium-browser"; fi
# If user requested full puppeteer
if [ "$USE_PUPPETEER" -eq 1 ]; then
  # If downloads are disabled and Chromium not present, fail
  PUPP_SKIP=${PUPPETEER_SKIP_CHROMIUM_DOWNLOAD:-1}
  if [ "$PUPP_SKIP" -eq 1 ] && [ -z "$CHROMIUM_BIN" ]; then echo "error: USE_PUPPETEER=1 but no Chromium found and PUPPETEER_SKIP_CHROMIUM_DOWNLOAD=1; set PUPPETEER_SKIP_CHROMIUM_DOWNLOAD=0 or install Chromium" | tee -a "$LOG" >&2; exit 5; fi
  RUNTIME_PKGS+=("puppeteer@^21.0.0")
else
  RUNTIME_PKGS+=("puppeteer-core@^21.0.0")
fi
# Prefer installing locally for reproducibility. If global binaries exist and user wants to skip local, record warning.
SKIP_LOCAL_INSTALL=0
if [ "${FORCE_LOCAL_INSTALL:-0}" = "1" ]; then SKIP_LOCAL_INSTALL=0; fi
if [ "${SKIP_LOCAL_INSTALL:-0}" = "1" ]; then echo "warning: skipping local install by environment flag" >> "$LOG"; fi
# Install using yarn if available else npm; capture output
if command -v yarn >/dev/null; then
  yarn add --cwd "$WORKSPACE" "${RUNTIME_PKGS[@]}" >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || { tail -n 200 "$LOG" >&2; exit 6; }
  yarn add --cwd "$WORKSPACE" --dev "${DEV_PKGS[@]}" >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || { tail -n 200 "$LOG" >&2; exit 7; }
else
  npm i --prefix "$WORKSPACE" --no-audit --no-fund "${RUNTIME_PKGS[@]}" >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || { tail -n 200 "$LOG" >&2; exit 6; }
  npm i --prefix "$WORKSPACE" --save-dev --no-audit --no-fund "${DEV_PKGS[@]}" >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || { tail -n 200 "$LOG" >&2; exit 7; }
fi
# Record chromium path if found
if [ -n "$CHROMIUM_BIN" ]; then echo "$CHROMIUM_BIN" > /tmp/figma_chromium_path.txt; fi
# Verify essential binaries exist (prefer local)
check_bin(){ if [ -x "$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/$1" ]; then echo "$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/$1"; elif command -v $1 >/dev/null; then command -v $1; else echo ""; fi }
TSC_BIN=$(check_bin tsc)
JEST_BIN=$(check_bin jest)
SERVE_BIN=$(check_bin serve)
# Record skipped local installs if relying on global
if [ -x "/usr/bin/node" ] && [ ! -x "$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/tsc" ] && command -v tsc >/dev/null; then echo "skipped_local_tsc=true" > /tmp/figma_skipped_local_install.txt || true; fi
if [ -z "$JEST_BIN" ]; then echo "error: jest not available locally or globally" | tee -a "$LOG" >&2; tail -n 100 "$LOG" >&2; exit 8; fi
if [ -f "$WORKSPACE/tsconfig.json" ] && [ -z "$TSC_BIN" ]; then echo "error: tsc not available locally or globally but tsconfig.json present" | tee -a "$LOG" >&2; tail -n 100 "$LOG" >&2; exit 9; fi
if [ -z "$SERVE_BIN" ]; then echo "error: serve not available locally or globally" | tee -a "$LOG" >&2; tail -n 100 "$LOG" >&2; exit 10; fi
# Evidence
node -e "console.log(Object.assign({},require('./package.json').dependencies||{}, require('./package.json').devDependencies||{}))" >/tmp/figma_installed_deps.txt || true
echo "deps_ok" > "$WORKSPACE/.setup_deps_done"
